title: (unofficial) Plants for a Future Data
description: An unofficial PFAF snapshot. The plant index was refreshed on 2026-10-17; most descriptions date from 2022. Detail and photo refreshes have independent timestamps. plant_data includes verified photo downloads.

columns.native_range: The current PFAF Native Range section; found_in is retained for compatibility.
columns.source_url: PFAF detail page used for this record.
columns.details_scraped_at: UTC ISO 8601 time of the last successful detail fetch. Null means unknown; cached responses do not advance this time.
columns.images_scraped_at: UTC ISO 8601 time of the last successful photo metadata fetch, including pages with no photos. Independent of details_scraped_at.
columns.images_error: Last photo refresh error. Failed source checks are excluded from plant_data.images.

image_downloads.description: Per-URL local paths, SHA-256 hashes, sizes, timestamps, and pending/ok/error download status. Only successful downloads from checked plant pages appear in plant_data.images.

columns.images: JSON array of verified photo entries with original url, source credit, and local path relative to the published archive root.
